title: Cap. II Arg. 4: 2 Tim. 2:21 — vessels unto honour from foresight of cleansing
pass_a_gloss: Fourth, that place is objected from 2 Tim. ii. 21, If a man shall have cleansed himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified and useful to the Lord. The vessels of election or of mercy therefore are those whom God foresaw and foreknew would cleanse themselves: Election therefore rests on foresight of holy works.
pass_b_english: Fourth: they bring 2 Tim. 2:21 — "If anyone cleanses himself from these, he will be a vessel unto honour, sanctified and useful to the Lord." So the vessels of election (or mercy) are those God foresaw would cleanse themselves: election, they say, rests on foresight of holy works.
source_text: Quarto, objicitur ille locus 2 Timoth. ii. 21, Si quis emundaverit se ab istis, erit vas in honorem sanctificatum & utile Domino. Vasa igitur electionis sive misericordiae illa sunt, quos Deus praevidit & praescivit sese emundaturos: Electio igitur nititur praevisione sanctorum operum.
